**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**

As a Program Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting the Business Operations & Strategic Initiatives (BOSI) team within Facilities Services, with a focus on capital construction project coordination, program reporting, and operational support. Working closely with Program Managers, Construction Directors, project teams, and cross-functional partners, you will help coordinate recurring project and program activities, maintain accurate reporting and documentation, and support standardized processes that strengthen project oversight and operational efficiency across a large and evolving construction portfolio.

In this role, you will support a variety of construction-related business and operational functions, including capital project reporting, financial review coordination, resource workload planning and tracking, dashboard maintenance, and program governance activities. Responsibilities include coordinating capital financial review meetings and preparing supporting materials, consolidating project budget and schedule information, maintaining Resource Load Plans (RLPs) and planned-versus-actual hours reporting, tracking project milestones and outstanding action items, and supporting the development and maintenance of project and portfolio dashboards. You will also coordinate stakeholder communications, maintain program documentation, and help ensure critical reporting activities and deliverables remain on schedule.

The Program Coordinator will play an important role in maintaining the accuracy, consistency, and accessibility of project and operational information. Drawing from systems such as PMWeb and other enterprise platforms, you will collect and validate project data, compile performance metrics, identify reporting discrepancies, and prepare materials for Program Managers and leadership review. You will also support process improvement initiatives by maintaining standardized templates, coordinating implementation activities, and helping improve reporting workflows and information management across the construction portfolio.

Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, analytical aptitude, effective communication, and the ability to independently coordinate multiple activities in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is proactive, collaborative, comfortable working with project data and reporting tools, and interested in supporting capital construction initiatives through structured coordination, reliable information management, and continuous process improvement.

Facilities Services enhances health through leadership, collaboration, and innovation. Our team provides essential non-clinical support 24/7, ensuring safe and efficient operations while planning for future growth. We represent the intersection of planning, construction, general services, and facilities operations. Learn more about Facilities Services at Stanford Health Care.

The Business Operations & Strategic Initiatives (BOSI) team supports the operational and strategic functions of Facilities Services, including budgeting, staffing, business process improvement, reporting, and organizational planning. Acting as a bridge between Facilities Services and strategic partners such as Human Resources, Finance, Supply Chain, Technology & Digital Solutions, and Legal, the team drives initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness and enable informed decision-making across the division.

**A Brief Overview**  
The Program Coordinator is responsible for a full range of planning, implementation and support of new and restructured programs that support Stanford Health Care (SHC) business development and customer service. The role is also in charge of planning and managing logistics for client relationship, marketing, and internal operations and others. The incumbent interfaces internally with Stanford Health Care (SHC), Lucile Packard Children's Hospital (LPCH), and School of Medicine (SOM) senior management, Corporate Partners and Executive Health Program Departments, Stanford Alumni networks and Stanford University Departments in all disciplines. External contacts include multinational corporations, medical centers, foundations and individual patients and families who have a relationship with Stanford Health Care.
  
  
The Program Coordinator carries out assigned duties independently and communicates constantly with Management. This role works collaboratively with a broad range of stakeholders in clinical, administrative, ancillary and service departments, and manages communication among all departments and School of Medicine.

**About Lao Family Community Development, Inc.**

Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD) is a community-based non-profit organization established in Richmond, Contra Costa County, California, in 1980. Since then, LFCD has expanded its operations to Alameda and Sacramento counties with its headquarters located in Oakland, California.

LFCD delivers programs and services from seven locations in more than 35 languages. The organization provides community development, affordable real estate, workforce development, education, and human services that primarily support low-income individuals and families, refugees, immigrants, transitional-age youth, seniors, individuals with disabilities, and other underserved populations.

**Job Summary:** LFCD is looking for a candidate to provide housing support services to the re-entry population, including community outreach efforts to form community collaborations, promote the understanding of the program, and build relationships with funders and partners to increase the number of referrals to the program. The candidate will work closely with onsite operational staff to provide ancillary services as needed. The position also manages participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medi-Cal (Cal-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non-clinical needs. The position duties include: outreach recruitment for potential landlords and preparing tenants to place in subsidized housing, case management, providing ongoing support to these individuals, and follow-up and retention services. This position will directly report to the Program Coordinator.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator II, III - Resilient Recovery
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
  
**The required shift for this position is:**  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
The Resilient Recovery Program provides youth and adults with substance use and co-occurring mental health services in the form of individual and group counseling and care coordination. This program is committed to working with underserved communities from a variety of backgrounds. We strive to meet the ongoing needs of individuals struggling with mental health issues, substance use disorders, and co-occurring mental health issues.
  
  
Care Coordinators are an important part of the San Mateo County Outpatient Program. Utilizing a trauma informed approach, they are responsible for assessing adult and youth client needs and strengths to collaboratively create treatment plans/problem lists with their clients that support their health and recovery. The care coordinator/counselor will provide individual and group counseling to adults and youth; deliver evidence-based curricula in accordance with program specific requirements. Care Coordinators assists clients in navigating systems of care while providing a supportive treatment environment.
  
  
May work weekends and holidays as needed.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
**Individual Treatment Responsibilities:**  

* Facilitates intakes/orientations, comprehensive assessments, individualized treatment planning, crisis, collateral, case management and individual counseling sessions with clients.
* Offers clinical support and counseling to assist clients in meeting their treatment goals including providing feedback, setting boundaries, and celebrating successes.
* Proactively links clients to both internal and external resources based on their treatment needs and follows up on the progress/status.

**Treatment Setting Responsibilities:**  

* Facilitates group counseling sessions and teaches classes on various treatment-related topics.
* Conducts screenings and intake assessments to determine client’s eligibility and ASAM level of care placement.
* Performs crisis intervention and communicates with treatment team as unforeseen situations arise.
* Completes and attends required training and meetings.
* Coordinate discharge planning in collaboration with the rest of the treatment team.
* Comply with certifying agency requirements for registration/certification renewal.
* Plans and facilitates client celebrations and special events.
* Will work one weekend day based on rotating schedule to facilitate the scheduled weekend groups.
* Will work at agency’s main office and in addition to co-location sites which may include schools, community health centers, in-home, and partner agencies.

**Documentation Responsibilities:**  

* Collaborates with each caseload client and other available internal and external resources to develop/maintain treatment plans/problem lists, transition/discharge plans, progress notes and appropriate updates in support of the health and recovery needs of the client.
* Properly documents all individual and group counseling sessions, intake and assessments, completes discharge paperwork and referrals in a timely manner as required by DMC and county.
* Maintains accurate records by entering documentation into various electronic systems for all caseload clients in accordance with guidelines established by HealthRIGHT 360 to satisfy internal and external evaluating requirements.
* Will participate in Peer Chart/ Utilization Reviews for preparation of program audits. Will adhere to documentation policies and procedures set forth by Compliance Department.
* Be responsive and proactive in all correspondences with referring parties such as behavioral health providers, probation, social workers, and the Quality Improvement Dept. via treatment status reports, phone calls, faxes, etc.
* Responds to records updates and corrections in a timely manner to ensure documentation compliance and accuracy.
* Will assist in providing written progress reports/narratives to Clinical Program Manager or Directors as requested.

**Productivity and Coverage Responsibilities:**  

* Must meet productivity standards as set forth by the organization, the minimum being 50% productivity.
* Ensure coverage during absences or unplanned events by coordinating with team members and management.
* Adjusts workload as necessary to ensure uninterrupted service delivery, including stepping in to provide support during peak demand times or staff shortages.
* Adheres to the program’s scheduling protocols to maintain appropriate client-to-provider ratios.

And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Education, Certification, and Experience
  

* High School diploma or equivalent OR associate degree in a related field/
* Must be registered as an Alcohol and Other Drug Counselor or as an SUD Counselor with CA approved certifying agency (CCAPP, CADTP, or CAADE).
* First Aid Certified within 30 days of employment.
* CPR Certified within 30 days of employment.
* 1 year of SUD experience required.

jobs.title: Sales Strategy & Operations Manager — Corporate & Public Sector
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the Role**

Smarsh is looking for a Manager of Sales Strategy & Operations to be the operating backbone for our Corporate and Public Sector sales segments. You'll own Sales Ops for both segments end to end — strategy, planning, and execution — and act as the primary Ops partner to the VP of Sales, turning data into the narrative and recommendations that drive their business.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you're as comfortable designing a territory model or building a forecast as you are presenting a recommendation to segment leadership. You’ll work closely with a Customer Success Operations counterpart supporting these same segments and help connect the pre- and post-sale operating model. This is an individual contributor role today, with potential to build and lead a team as the segments scale.

### **How will you contribute?**

**Sales strategy & planning**

* Own annual and in-year planning for Corporate and Public Sector: territory design, account segmentation, quota setting, and capacity planning.
* Translate segment strategy into operating plans, priorities, and resourcing decisions in partnership with the VP of Sales and their leadership team.
* Identify risks and opportunities in the business before they show up in bookings, and bring recommendations, not just observations.

**Forecasting, pipeline & revenue cadence**

* Run the forecasting and pipeline management process for both segments: cadence, hygiene, deal inspection, and accuracy.
* Build and maintain the operating rhythm — pipeline reviews, forecast reviews, QBRs — that keeps segment leadership aligned and accountable.
* Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, and Commissions on deal structuring, quota attainment, and incentive execution for your segments.

**Reporting, analytics & business reviews**

* Build the reporting and dashboards that give a trusted, real-time view of pipeline, forecast, and performance.
* Go beyond status reporting — use cohort, funnel, and productivity analysis to explain what's driving performance and what to do about it.
* Own the analytics behind monthly and quarterly business reviews for Corporate and Public Sector.

**Cross-functional & systems partnership**

* Partner with Enterprise Applications to translate Sales Ops needs into systems requirements, and help prioritize the roadmap for tools these segments depend on (Salesforce, forecasting, sales engagement/intelligence platforms).
* Align closely with the CS Ops partner on these segments to connect new business, renewal, and expansion data and processes.
* Build strong working relationships with Finance, Marketing, and Enterprise Applications, and influence outcomes without formal authority over those teams.

**AI & process innovation**

* Bring an AI-first mindset: identify where AI and automation can improve forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and day-to-day seller productivity for these segments.
* Pilot new tools and approaches proactively rather than waiting to be asked, and scale what works.

### **What will you bring?**

* 4+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a closely related GTM function, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Experience with territory design, quota setting, and annual sales planning processes.
* Deep, hands-on experience with Salesforce, including reporting and dashboard build.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable building models and pipeline/forecast analysis from scratch, not just reviewing someone else's output.
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and presenting recommendations clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Background in management consulting or investment banking, particularly with an MBA. (Preferred)
* Experience supporting Public Sector or regulated-industry sales motions.(Preferred)
* Practical, hands-on use of AI tools in a Sales Ops context, with a point of view on where AI can change how a sales org operates.(Preferred)
* SQL skills and experience building in PowerBI. (Preferred)

Any applicable bonus programs will be discussed during the recruiting process.

The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer.

**About our culture**

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

jobs.title: Staff Revenue Operations Manager, Revenue Planning & Analytics
jobs.description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We are looking for a Staff Revenue Operations Manager to help shape how EvenUp plans for and achieves its growth targets. As we scale our go-to-market organization, this person will own the bottoms-up revenue model that connects company-level goals to the underlying assumptions across our Sales and broader GTM teams.

You'll partner closely with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to build annual and quarterly plans, evaluate revenue performance, and conduct the strategic analyses that inform decisions around sales capacity, quotas, territories, and resource allocation. This is a highly analytical role that requires both strong modeling skills and the ability to translate complex business questions into clear recommendations.

**Title and compensation to be determined based on candidate experience.**

**What you'll do:**

* **Own revenue planning and forecasting:** Build and maintain EvenUp's bottoms-up GTM model, connecting revenue targets to the underlying drivers of performance, including pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, sales capacity, ramp time, churn, and expansion. Translate company-level growth targets into detailed operating assumptions and forecasts.
* **Lead annual and quarterly planning:** Partner with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to develop annual and quarterly plans across relevant departments. Evaluate what needs to be true across headcount, productivity, conversion, and retention to achieve our goals, identifying key assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
* **Drive strategic GTM analysis:** Lead analyses that inform how we structure and allocate our GTM resources, including territory design, customer segmentation, quota setting, capacity planning, and sales productivity. Develop recommendations that help leadership make informed tradeoffs as the business scales.
* **Evaluate business performance:** Analyze actual performance against plan, identify the underlying drivers of variances, and assess their implications for future results. Build scenarios and sensitivities to help leadership understand potential outcomes and determine where adjustments are needed.
* **Partner with GTM leadership:** Serve as a strategic thought partner to Revenue Operations and functional leaders, translating complex analyses into clear insights and recommendations. Help leaders pressure-test assumptions, evaluate investment decisions, and prioritize opportunities to improve revenue performance.
* **Strengthen planning methodologies:** Improve the models, assumptions, and analytical approaches used to plan and forecast the business. Partner with Finance, Data, and other cross-functional teams as needed to ensure planning is grounded in reliable data and reflects how EvenUp's GTM organization operates.

**What we look for:**

* **Relevant experience:** 10+ years of experience in Revenue Planning & Analytics, GTM Strategy & Planning, Strategic Finance, Sales Finance, Revenue Operations, or a related function, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
* **Revenue modeling expertise:** You have built and owned a bottoms-up revenue forecast, sales capacity model, or comparable operating model. You understand how assumptions around pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, ramp time, churn, and expansion translate into business outcomes.
* **Strong analytical and quantitative skills:** You can build models from scratch, evaluate scenarios, pressure-test assumptions, and break down complex business questions into structured analyses. You are comfortable working with large datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* **GTM and SaaS business acumen:** You understand the drivers of revenue growth in a recurring-revenue business and how decisions around sales capacity, territory design, segmentation, quotas, and productivity affect performance.
* **Strategic problem-solving:** You can identify the right questions to investigate, determine what the data needs to show, and develop recommendations that help leaders make decisions about planning, resource allocation, and GTM strategy.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** You communicate analytical findings clearly and can work directly with senior stakeholders to challenge assumptions, align on plans, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.
* **Ownership and execution:** You are comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment, managing ambiguous problems independently, and building planning models and processes that can evolve as the business scales.

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

jobs.description:
**About Us**

At **BGBx**, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Project Manager, Commercial Strategy & Innovation will serve as a strategic and operational partner to the Chief of Commercial Strategy & Innovation. This role will bring structure, organization, and proactive follow-through to cross-BGBx growth efforts across Consulting, Communications, Medical Communications, Payer, Data, AI, and Technology. This role will coordinate the people, materials, decisions, and follow-through required to move integrated client solutions and cross-planning forward. This is a hands-on senior project manager and strategic operations role that combines account planning, meeting and calendar management, pipeline coordination, leadership preparation, and cross-functional execution.

**R****esponsibilities**

* Coordinate cross-BGBx account planning for priority pharmaceutical clients, including top-to-top meetings, QBRs, client touchpoints, follow-ups, and cross-planning.
* Manage the head of Commercial Strategy & Innovation's calendar and the logistics for key leadership and client activities, using business context to prioritize time, ensure the right participants are included, prepare, agendas and materials, and meetings drive to clear decisions and next steps.
* Maintain a forward-looking view of account priorities, client milestones, proposal deadlines, leadership meetings, and cross-solving activity.
* Track the enterprise pipeline, account plans, opportunity stages, owners, next actions, follow-ups, and available revenue attribution across priority accounts; maintain visibility and accountability without owning revenue decisions
* Proactively identify gaps, conflicts, stalled opportunities, missing owners, and decisions that require escalation.
* Build a working understanding of BGBx's capabilities and know which relationship executives, capability experts, solution leads, and delivery teams to pull in, and when, based on client needs and opportunity requirements. Support IxI and Commercial Strategy revenue BLT reporting by coordinating inputs from cross-functional teams, tracking opportunities, owners, next steps, and available revenue attribution, and helping maintain visibility and accountability without owning revenue targets, revenue decisions, or attribution.
* Prepare internal stakeholders for strategic meetings by developing agendas, briefing materials, late-breaking account updates, presentations, and support stakeholders with recommended next steps and follow-through.
* Support the execution and coordination of repeatable account-planning tools, proposal processes, handoff workflows, governance models, and performance-tracking systems.
* Coordinate follow-through after meetings and governance forums, ensuring that commitments are documented, owners are clear, and actions progress to completion.

**What makes the role distinctive**

* This role sits at the intersection of strategic project management and execution. The successful candidate will help BGBx leaders make better use of their time, stay aligned across divisions, and turn cross-BGBx conversations into organized, accountable action
* The role is well suited to a highly organized, proactive, and strategic project manager who is comfortable managing details while understanding the broader business objective. This person should be able to move between calendar coordination, pipeline tracking, senior leadership preparation, executive content development, and cross-functional problem-solving.

**Ideal candidate profile**

* Strong organizational and project-management skills, with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
* Ready to dive in, roll-up-sleeves, diligent, real-time senior meeting mapping, scheduling and actions post client meetings
* Proactive working style, with the judgment to anticipate needs, surface issues, and move work forward without constant direction.
* Strategic thinker who can connect individual meetings and opportunities to broader account and enterprise-growth objectives.
* Comfortable working across senior leaders, client teams, and multiple BGBx practice areas.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated ability to draft, synthesize, and refine executive-ready presentations, briefing materials, account updates and other content
* 5 years of experience in Project management, strategic operations, account management, or a related field with demonstrated independence in complex, senior stakeholder environments
* An MBA or equivalent business experience is preferred.

**Salary Range:** $90,000 - $120,000

BGBx is headquartered in New York City, and the salary range listed reflects the expected base compensation for this role in the New York City metropolitan area. **This position may be performed remotely within the United States.** For candidates located outside the New York City area, compensation will be adjusted to reflect the applicable market for the employee's primary work location. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

**What We Offer**
